description: This line plot illustrates the average repetition rate across various relation categories for different training sample generation methods. The x-axis, labeled “Relation Category,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled “Average Repetition Rate,” is also linear, spanning from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays six distinct lines: a solid blue line with circular markers representing “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint,” an orange line with triangular markers for “DPO,” a dashed blue line with circular markers for “Average of w/o DPO obo,” a dashed orange line with triangular markers for “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint,” a solid green line with triangular markers for “Average of DPO,” and a solid green line with circular markers for “DPO.” The solid blue line starts at approximately 0.227 and exhibits significant fluctuations, peaking at 0.6 near relation category 30 before declining. The orange line begins at approximately 0.163 and remains relatively stable with minor fluctuations, staying mostly above 0.1. The green line starts at approximately 0.117 and remains consistently low, fluctuating around 0.1. The dashed blue and dashed orange lines represent averages and remain relatively flat near 0.163 and 0.227 respectively, while the solid green line for “Average of DPO” remains near 0.117.
